# Round Table Mauritius AGM 2027

> Public information site for the Round Table Mauritius National Annual General Meeting at Cotton Bay Resort & Spa, Rodrigues.

Canonical URL: https://rtm-agm-2027-rodrigues.vercel.app/

This file summarises only facts already published on the site and its content source notes. Prices, bank details, and programme items that the site marks TBA are left unpublished here too.

## Event

- Name: Round Table Mauritius Annual General Meeting 2027 (RTM AGM 2027)
- Motto: Adopt · Adapt · Improve
- Brand: Round Table Mauritius only
- Dates: Thursday 13 – Sunday 16 May 2027 (three nights)
- Venue: Cotton Bay Resort & Spa, Pointe Coton, Rodrigues
- Coordinates shown on the site: 19°43′S · 63°25′E
- Who: Tablers, partners and children
- AGM sessions are members only. Partners and children are welcome on the trip and at the resort, not in sessions.
- Meeting space: outdoor marquee / bedouin tent on the sand, seats 100 to 150 Tablers
- Public mailbox on the site: secretary.rtm@gmail.com

## Destination

Cotton Bay is a four-star beachfront retreat at Pointe Coton, on the eastern edge of Rodrigues — twenty-five minutes from Plaine Corail airport (Sir Gaëtan Duval / RRG). The resort has 88 rooms (sleeps 2+2), a 260 m² infinity pool, a private beach, spa and gym (08:00–20:00), and two restaurants.

The official programme stays at Cotton Bay. Island notes on the site include Trou d'Argent, Île aux Cocos, wooden pirogues, and a Creole table.

## Travel

- Air Mauritius only · MRU ↔ RRG · about 1 hour 35 minutes
- About four flights a day on current patterns; book early — single carrier
- The 2027 timetable is not yet published
- Thursday evening in, Sunday evening out
- Return fare in the package is about Rs 10,000 per adult, including airport transport
- Child fare is still TBC (the on-page calculator uses an estimate of Rs 6,000)

## Weekend

- Thu 13 May — Arrive: evening flight in, transfer and check-in, welcome dinner
- Fri 14 May — AGM day (members): breakfast, sessions under the marquee, afternoon at leisure, dinner
- Sat 15 May — Gala: sessions / excursion, the gala dinner, BYO spirits and wine
- Sun 16 May — Depart: breakfast, late checkout, evening flight home

## What every ticket includes

1. Three nights, half board (breakfast and dinner every day — six meals)
2. Flights and transfers (return Air Mauritius MRU–RRG and airport transport)
3. AGM under the marquee
4. Welcome and gala dinners
5. The bar at −50% (cocktails, wine and spirits); BYO wine and spirits free of corkage; staffed to 23:00, then self-service
6. The resort and beach (infinity pool, private beach, spa and gym, two restaurants)

## Indicative tickets

Prices are per person for the full three nights, drinks aside. They are indicative and provisional until the event budget and flights are confirmed. Figures come from the RTM booking sheet and financials brief.

| Ticket | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Member — sharing | ~Rs 29,700 |
| Member — single | ~Rs 35,700 |
| Companion (no AGM) | ~Rs 25,300 |
| Child (shares room) | Rs 4,200 + flight |

Sharing is the most affordable way to attend. Rooms sleep two adults and two children on a sofa bed.

## Optional extras (paid separately)

- Spa treatments — 10–30% off (exact band still to be confirmed)
- Tours and activities
- Traditional fishing
- Lunches — TBC whether bundled or sold as an add-on
- Extra drinks — all −50%
- Daily activities — the resort may lay on complimentary daily activities

## Payment

Reserve by bank transfer once official details are issued. Quote a booking reference. Deposit amount, due date, bank name, account number, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, and cancellation terms remain to be confirmed. Nothing is due until RTM publishes them.

The public form is a preview: submitting shows a reference on the page. No payment is taken on the site.

## Still unpublished on the public site

- Final event budget / levy (Rs 3,000 is illustrative)
- Child Air Mauritius fare (Rs 6,000 is an estimate)
- Bank name, account, IBAN, SWIFT
- Deposit amount and due date
- Cancellation terms
- Lunch: bundle vs add-on
- Spa discount exact %
- Late Sunday checkout in writing
- 2027 flight schedule / group fare
- Official Cotton Bay photography and a past-AGM quote / film
